{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove the six QA orders with revenue 999999.99
sales = sales[sales['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered = sales[
    (sales['channel'] == 'paid_search') &
    (sales['customer_segment'] == 'new')
]

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of converted orders
conversion_rate = filtered['converted'].mean()

# Print the exact value to ensure it's captured
print(conversion_rate)

# Now, explicitly extract and print the value to be reported
# This includes the exact float value from the computation
final_value = conversion_rate
print(final_value)

# Also, explicitly print the numerator and denominator for full transparency
num_converted = filtered['converted'].sum()
num_total = len(filtered)
print(f"Converted: {num_converted}")
print(f"Total: {num_total}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}")"}
